events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the iconic co-founder, co-lead vocalist, and rhythm guitarist of The Beatles, would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, best known as a co-founder of Monty Python and for Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was originally released on November 22, 1968, featuring 30 tracks and a stark white cover.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: A landmark in music history! The Beatles' 'White Album' originally dropped on this day in '68, a double LP that showcased their incredible range. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: 35 Years Since Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who left an indelible mark on music history.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost an icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Play a Queen track in his honour.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul,' featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood,' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and showed a new side to the Fab Four. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: 46 Years Since John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, the visionary artist whose music and message continue to resonate globally.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His artistry, activism, and pursuit of peace echo louder than ever. What's his most meaningful song to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the legendary 'Starman' and an icon of innovation in music and fashion, would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator whose influence continues to shape music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today, forever remembered for revolutionising popular music.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. The King of Rock and Roll still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, turns 83 today, celebrated for his innovative riffs and monumental influence on rock music.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His groundbreaking work with Led Zeppelin changed rock forever. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer known for his distinctive raspy voice and decades of hits, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today! A true showman with a voice that's instantly recognisable. What's your go-to Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Maestro
angles.copy: It's a 'House of Fun' today as Suggs from Madness turns 66! Wishing the iconic frontman a very happy birthday.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, famous for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home),' turns 71 today.

angles.name: Paul Young's Day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced Paul Young! Still got that soulful touch.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday, renowned for her songwriting, iconic style, and philanthropy.

angles.name: Dolly's 81st
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon of music, fashion, and pure joy. Here's to more sparkles!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and television personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, a true British music legend.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, turns 77 today.

angles.name: Billy's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' and celebrate his amazing career.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame First Induction
events.blurb: On January 23, 1986, the first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame took place in New York City, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Looking back to January 23, 1986, when the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. What an iconic class to kick things off!
